headline: New ECAs: 0.10% Sulphur From 1 March 2027
insight: From 1 March 2027 ships in the Canadian Arctic and Norwegian Sea ECAs must use fuel of 0.10% sulphur or less, unless an approved equivalent is used.

sources.title: New Emission Control Areas: Canadian Arctic and Norwegian Sea (MEPC.392(82))

meta.description: The Canadian Arctic and the Norwegian Sea are Emission Control Areas under MARPOL Annex VI. The 0.10% sulphur limit applies from 1 March 2027.
meta.question: Has your company already planned fuel for these areas?
